sql<!\[CDATA\[select b.\*, c.accname, a.a\_type, a.m\_type from ( select distinct accid, a\_type, m\_type from odata\_n\_xir.t\_ttrd\_acc\_balance\_secu\_his where busi\_date = '2025-07-01' and accid in ( select distinct accid from odata\_n\_xir.e\_gf\_xir\_acc\_pc where busi\_date = '2025-07-01' and p2 = '场外衍生品部' ) ) a left join ( select packagename, p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, accid from odata\_n\_xir.e\_gf\_xir\_acc\_pc where busi\_date = '2025-07-01' and p2 = '场外衍生品部' ) b on a.accid = b.accid left join (select \* from odata\_n\_xir.t\_TTRD\_ACC\_SECU where busi\_date= '2025-07-01') c on b.accid=c.accid\]\]>
